_about: Grassroots Facebook group intros (Tiffany Nov 11 5:15+5:28pm). ONE group a day, 7 a week, posted as Tiffany from her Facebook in Chrome. Claude finds small mahjong groups with loose promo rules, reads each group's rules, writes a different intro per group in her voice (graphic designer, obsessed with mahj, built Find Your Mat-ch out of necessity to mock up tiles on mats without 10,000 screenshots; wants feedback from enthusiastic players). She approves the WHOLE WEEK on one page (groups + exact text); that yes covers those 7 posts. She is ASKED EVERY DAY (scripts/checks/fb_groups_check.py on the front door). Never post the same text twice; never in a group whose rules ban promo; reply to comments; log every post here. Joining a group (answering its questions) is shown to her first. FEEDBACK (Tiffany Nov 11 7:38pm): every intro gives the feedback form link AND invites comments on the post (comments help it circulate). FOLLOW-UP: every posted group is re-checked daily for 14 days (comments, replies, feedback logged in docs/FB-FEEDBACK.md, group rated good/dud/sellers-only). CADENCE (7:38pm): groups whose rules allow repeat promo get ONE post a week max (new album / what's new), never 2-3; duds are dropped after she sees the rating.

days.info: 3.1K members · pretty tables, mats and tiles · no promo rule listed
days.text:
Hi everyone! I'm Tiffany. I'm a graphic designer who fell hard for mahj, and honestly the tiles and mats are half the reason.

Every time a new mat came out, I'd try to picture my tiles on it, and I ended up with about 10,000 screenshots on my phone. So I built a tool for it: Find Your Mat-ch™. Pick your tiles (or your mat) and it matches them with 1,300+ mats, then mocks them up on a table with racks. It's free: mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-match

There's lots of other eye candy on the site too: holiday albums for 11 new holiday tile sets, and match albums for 40 more tile sets and counting. I release a new album at least once a week, and you can request the ones you'd like me to make.

Just looking for players who love the game and all the pretty things that come with it. If you try it, I'd love your feedback: mahjmatchmaker.com/find-your-mat-ch-feedback. Or just leave it in the comments here. I really appreciate it! 💕
